blocks.title: Business plan
blocks.text: A business plan is a document that describes a business idea, how it will be made successful and the steps to reach its goals, helping you think through important details before starting.

blocks.prompt: What is the first step in creating a business plan (MCQ 3)?

items: A business plan documents the idea, the path to success and the steps.
